description: Personal finance dashboard powered by Monzo. Transactions tagged 'internal' or 'savings' are excluded from all totals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS value
FROM transactions
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND amount > 0
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) AS value
FROM personal_spend_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  AND (amount < 0 OR is_reimbursement)
  AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
           ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')));

WITH income AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS v
  FROM transactions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount > 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
), spend AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) AS v
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
)
SELECT (income.v - spend.v) AS value FROM income, spend;

panels.description: Average raw spend per month over the selected range. Excludes internal/savings.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS m, SUM(-amount) AS spend
  FROM transactions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')) OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))

)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(spend), 0) AS value FROM monthly;

panels.title: Avg monthly spend

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT occurred_at::date AS day, SUM(-amount) AS spend
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND (amount < 0 OR is_reimbursement)
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  day::timestamptz AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(spend) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 15 FOLLOWING), 2) AS "30-day rolling smooth"
FROM daily
ORDER BY day

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT occurred_at::date AS day, SUM(-amount) AS spend
  FROM transactions
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings')
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ','))
         OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  day::timestamptz AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(spend) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 14 PRECEDING AND 15 FOLLOWING), 2) AS "30-day rolling raw"
FROM daily
ORDER BY day

panels.description: Filtered by the category dropdown above. Default 'All' shows everything including internal/savings.

FROM transactions

panels.title: All transactions

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS month, category,
         ROUND(SUM(-amount), 2) AS spend
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE amount < 0 AND source_kind = 'transaction'
    AND category NOT IN ('transfer', 'internal')
    AND occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - interval '2 months')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
m0 AS (SELECT category, spend FROM monthly WHERE month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)),
m1 AS (SELECT category, spend FROM monthly WHERE month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - interval '1 month')),
m2 AS (SELECT category, spend FROM monthly WHERE month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - interval '2 months'))
SELECT
  COALESCE(m0.category, m1.category, m2.category) AS category,
  ROUND(COALESCE(m2.spend, 0), 2) AS "2 months ago",
  ROUND(COALESCE(m1.spend, 0), 2) AS "last month",
  ROUND(COALESCE(m0.spend, 0), 2) AS "this month"
FROM m0
FULL OUTER JOIN m1 USING (category)
FULL OUTER JOIN m2 USING (category)
ORDER BY COALESCE(m0.spend, 0) DESC

Monthly spend split by account (Monzo / Santander / Revolut).

panels.title: Spend by account over time

panels.description: Savings rate = (income − spend) ÷ income × 100. Income = all positive amounts (salary, reimbursements). The green threshold at 20% is a common benchmark.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)  AS income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS spend
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
  GROUP BY 1
),
rates AS (
  SELECT month,
         ROUND(100.0 * (income - spend) / NULLIF(income, 0), 1) AS rate
  FROM monthly
  WHERE income > 0
)
SELECT
  month::timestamptz AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(rate) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS savings_rate_pct
FROM rates
ORDER BY month

panels.title: Savings rate % per month

panels.description: Each cell = that category's spend as % of its own monthly average in the selected period. Yellow ≈ normal, green = unusually low, red = unusually high.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1M') AS time,
    category AS metric,
    SUM(-amount) AS spend
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND source_kind = 'transaction'
    AND category <> 'transfer'
    AND CASE WHEN '${category:csv}' = '*' THEN TRUE
             ELSE category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')) END
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
avg_per_cat AS (
  SELECT metric, AVG(spend) AS avg_spend
  FROM monthly
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  m.time,
  m.metric,
  ROUND(100.0 * m.spend / NULLIF(a.avg_spend, 0), 1) AS value
FROM monthly m
JOIN avg_per_cat a USING (metric)
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Monthly spend intensity by category

panels.description: Daily spend intensity by day of week. Darker green = higher spend day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(occurred_at, '1M') AS time,
    EXTRACT(isodow FROM occurred_at)::text || ' ' || TO_CHAR(occurred_at, 'Dy') AS metric,
    SUM(-amount) AS spend
  FROM personal_spend_daily
  WHERE $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
    AND amount < 0
    AND source_kind = 'transaction'
    AND category NOT IN ('internal', 'savings', 'investment', 'transfer')
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
avg_per_day AS (
  SELECT metric, AVG(spend) AS avg_spend FROM daily GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  d.time,
  d.metric,
  ROUND(100.0 * d.spend / NULLIF(a.avg_spend, 0), 1) AS value
FROM daily d
JOIN avg_per_day a USING (metric)
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Gross spend, reimbursements received, and net cost per group.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  name                                                      AS "Group",
  kind                                                      AS "Kind",
  ROUND(gross_cost, 2)                                      AS "Gross",
  ROUND(reimbursed, 2)                                      AS "Reimbursed",
  ROUND(net_cost, 2)                                        AS "Net",
  ROUND(budget, 2)                                          AS "Budget",
  ROUND(100.0 * reimbursed / NULLIF(gross_cost, 0), 1)     AS "Paid back %"

WHERE gross_cost > 0
  AND ('${group:csv}' = '*' OR id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
ORDER BY net_cost DESC

panels.title: Group costs

panels.description: Cumulative net cost per group within the selected time window. Each step adds a month's gross spend (post-split) and subtracts that month's reimbursements, so the right-hand edge of each line is the running total. Use the Group selector to focus on one lease/holiday/project.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', occurred_at)::timestamptz AS time,
    COALESCE(group_id, offset_for_group) AS grp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN group_id IS NOT NULL THEN -amount * my_share ELSE -amount END) AS monthly_value
  FROM transactions
  WHERE (group_id IS NOT NULL OR offset_for_group IS NOT NULL)
    AND ('${group:csv}' = '*'
         OR group_id = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ','))
         OR offset_for_group = ANY(string_to_array('${group:csv}', ',')))
    AND ('${category:csv}' = '*' OR category = ANY(string_to_array('${category:csv}', ',')))
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT time, grp AS metric,
         SUM(monthly_value) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY time) AS value
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM cumulative
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Reconciliation queue

panels.description: Vanguard ISA value (line) vs total deposited (line). Gap = market gain. Snapshot via `python poller.py snapshot vanguard_isa YYYY-MM-DD BAL CONTRIB`.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT observed_at::timestamptz AS time,
       balance               AS "Value",
       contributions_to_date AS "Deposited"

WHERE account_id = 'vanguard_isa'
  AND $__timeFilter(observed_at::timestamptz)
ORDER BY observed_at;

panels.title: ISA growth vs contributions

panels.description: Month-over-month change in total net worth. Green = wealth grew, red = declined.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', day)::timestamptz AS month,
    SUM(balance) AS total_worth
  FROM net_worth_daily
  WHERE day IN (
    SELECT MAX(day) FROM net_worth_daily
    GROUP BY date_trunc('month', day)
  )
  GROUP BY 1
),
changes AS (
  SELECT month AS time,
         ROUND(total_worth - LAG(total_worth) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS delta
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  time,
  CASE WHEN delta >= 0 THEN delta ELSE NULL END AS "Growth",
  CASE WHEN delta <  0 THEN delta ELSE NULL END AS "Loss"
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time
